evidence_excerpt: big data infrastructure that leverages machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities to further enhance the customer experience by transforming the last mile delivery
evidence_summary: Aramex announced an AWS-based data platform already leveraging ML/AI; the platform increased shipping-date prediction accuracy by 74% and was designed to transform last-mile delivery.
adoption_interpretation: Core operational AI is observed in 2019; true adoption is left-censored at <=2019 until 2018 disclosures are searched under the same protocol.
notes: Last-mile prediction is a core logistics function and the disclosure reports a realized 74% accuracy improvement, supporting score 3 rather than pilot/rhetoric.

evidence_excerpt: Geocoder, which utilizes machine learning and predictive AI to predict and generate precise delivery coordinates
evidence_summary: Aramex's proprietary geocoder used ML and predictive AI to generate delivery coordinates, supporting a live-tracking last-mile feature tested in the UAE in 2023.
adoption_interpretation: Confirms persistent core AI use in a last-mile delivery function by 2023; does not change the <=2019 left-censored adoption status.
notes: The customer live-tracking feature was being tested, but the underlying proprietary geocoder is described as an existing ML/predictive-AI system; score 3 is anchored to that operational geocoder rather than to the customer-feature trial.
